teachingQuestion: How do physical and logical controls combine to protect one asset?
focalInsight: The same business access decision can cross administrative, physical, logical, and evidence boundaries.
title: Access-control boundaries
caption: A protected object is surrounded by policy, physical, logical, and accountability controls.

nodes.label: Protected object
nodes.detail: Information, system, device, facility, application, service

altSummary: A stack shows policy governing physical and logical access boundaries around a protected object, with both boundaries producing accountability evidence.
textFallback: Start with the owner-approved policy. Apply physical controls to presence, movement, and handling, and logical controls to information and system operations. Both paths protect the object and should produce evidence for review and revocation.
